notes.title: The New Demo Is Here!
notes.content: [h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1][p][b]---------------------------------[/b][/p][p][b]Over the past few months we have been hard at work developing more content for Unsent. Since we have changed a lot in the game since May, we decided it would be a good idea to release an updated demo that better reflects the final game that we intend to release.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Please enjoy the new features and join our discord if you want to be part of our community! [/b][url="https://discord.gg/uVhKn3ZS9M"]https://discord.gg/uVhKn3ZS9M[/url][/p][p][b]---------------------------------[/b][/p][p][b]All New:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Intro Sequence[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Valentine Animations[/p][/*][*][p]Save System[/p][/*][*][p]Shop System[/p][/*][*][p]SFX[/p][/*][*][p]VFX[/p][/*][*][p]Interactions[/p][/*][*][p]Super Jump[/p][/*][/list][p][b]---------------------------------[/b][/p][p][b]Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Main Menu[/p][/*][*][p]Settings Menu[/p][/*][*][p]HUD improvements[/p][/*][*][p]SFX improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Stamp Journal[/p][/*][*][p]Movement Tweaks[/p][/*][*][p]Quality of life improvements[/p][/*][/list][p][b]---------------------------------[/b][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed “Unstuck” option not working as intended[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Main Menu music not being affected by volume controls[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Vaultilda would disappear[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various collision issues [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various menu issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where you could start the game while in the credits[/p][/*][*][p][b]And many more that would make this list unbearably long.[/b][/p][/*][/list]
